back: Genes on the same autosome tend to be inherited together and do not assort independently.
An offspring or gamete with a new combination of linked alleles, produced by crossing over.

front: Test cross result for linked genes
back: Two large parental classes and two small recombinant classes (not 1 : 1 : 1 : 1).

front: Why are recombinants fewer than parentals?
back: They need a crossover between the two loci, which happens only in some cells.
Interaction in which alleles of one gene mask or modify the expression of another gene.
9 black : 3 brown : 4 yellow; ee masks the B gene.

front: Two-step pigment pathway with recessive non-functional alleles
back: Coloured only if both enzymes work (A_B_): 9 coloured : 7 white.

front: Sign of epistasis in an F2
back: Fewer than four classes, ratios still in sixteenths (e.g. 9 : 3 : 4, 9 : 7, 13 : 3).
